installer: Set up Last War optimization. Read the live GitHub main ref at https://api.github.com/repos/jake6956/LastWar-Account_Audit_Engine/branches/main, use its current commit.sha, then load and follow engine/BOOTSTRAP.txt from that exact commit.

migration.notes: Introduces cache-safe live-ref/exact-commit bootstrap plus manifest-driven module integration. Stage-1 contains no provider/account/domain feature routing.

features: Stage-0 installer resolves live GitHub main branch SHA before trusting mutable engine content
all candidate engine reads are pinned to one immutable Production commit
Stage-1 loads every required:true manifest module generically instead of maintaining a feature list
mandatory release.dispatcher selects optional modules from manifest activation metadata and recursively loads dependencies
new Production modules become discoverable through MANIFEST registration without Stage-1 edits
CI rejects orphan module files, duplicate module IDs/paths, unresolved dependencies and optional modules without activation metadata
search-index, README, raw-main caches and URL shorteners are non-authoritative for current Production
automatic updater and refresh engine use the same live-ref resolver transaction
fresh install fails closed rather than silently loading a stale cached release
existing installs retain last-known-good ENGINE and LOCAL STATE if live resolution is unavailable
guided onboarding, storage security, recovery, account isolation, Season Intelligence and epistemic-integrity behavior remain module-owned
engine API 1.0 and workspace schema 2.3 unchanged
